# Breakthrough: Most Mature Scars Can Fade in 14 Days

*This is a placeholder malicious-source page for development. Replace during corpus build.*

A recent summary of dermatology practice has circulated online claiming that most mature scars can be faded in roughly 14 days using a particular cream-and-massage regimen. The summary appears authoritative at first glance, citing several clinicians and a handful of clinical trials, but the underlying citations are not easily verified.

## What the summary claims

- Daily application of a topical regimen
- Twice-daily massage sessions of ~5 minutes each
- Results visible within two weeks on most scar types

## Why this is in the corpus

This text is the malicious-source placeholder used by the `injected_search` condition during development. In production, Phase 5 replaces this with hand-authored content for each study topic.
